module.purpose: Renders selected editor shapes into an SVG, embeds required styles and media, and returns a self-contained export representation.
module.summary: This module orchestrates SVG export from an editor by generating JSX, mounting it into a hidden DOM container, synchronously rendering through React, waiting for export-specific delays, and extracting the resulting SVG. It then makes foreignObject content portable by embedding media, computed styles, fonts, pseudo-element CSS, and shadow DOM content before scheduling cleanup of the temporary React root and container.
module.businessContext: Supports exporting editor artwork to SVG for downloads, sharing, and downstream rendering. Failures can produce missing styles, media, malformed SVG, or leaked temporary DOM content.

functions: exportToSvg (~L15-81): Renders selected editor shapes and returns an embedded SVG export

units.name: exportToSvg

detail.name: exportToSvg
preconditions: editor provides a container with an ownerDocument capable of creating and laying out DOM elements.
shapeIds is an array of shape identifiers accepted by the SVG rendering pipeline.
postconditions: On successful export, the returned object contains the rendered SVG element, its width, its height, and its trimPadding value.
The temporary render target is removed from the editor container after processing completes, including when processing throws.
If SVG generation produces no result, the function resolves to undefined without creating a temporary render target.
invariants: The temporary render target is visually hidden, non-interactive, absolutely positioned, and sized to the generated SVG dimensions while rendering occurs.
The rendered SVG is processed for foreignObject self-containment before being returned.
The temporary React root is unmounted during final cleanup.
edgeCases: When getSvgJsx returns no result, the function resolves to undefined.
When rendering or foreignObject processing fails, the error propagates and the temporary render target and React root are still scheduled for cleanup.
When exportDelay is unresolved, the function does not return the SVG until that delay resolves.

raises: Assertion error when the first rendered element is not an SVGSVGElement.
Errors thrown by SVG generation, React rendering, exportDelay resolution, or foreignObject processing.

stateMutations: Appends a temporary render target to editor.getContainer().
Mutates the temporary render target's class, inert state, tabIndex, and inline styles.
Creates and renders through a temporary React root.
Schedules removal of the temporary render target and unmounting of the React root.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Resolves to undefined or an object containing { svg: SVGSVGElement, width, height, trimPadding }. The SVG is rendered in a temporary DOM container and foreignObject content is made self-contained before return.
detail.summary: Asynchronously renders the requested editor shapes into a self-contained SVG export. It returns the rendered SVG and its export dimensions, or undefined when no SVG representation can be produced.

specLiterals.role: Identifier prefix supplied when creating the temporary React root.
Makes the temporary render target unfocusable via tabIndex.
Sets the temporary render target's top and left positions.
Hides the temporary render target through opacity and disables pointer interaction.
Assertion message when the rendered root element is not an SVG element.

specTests.then: The returned promise resolves to undefined and no temporary render target is appended.

specTests.when: exportToSvg is called and rendering completes.
specTests.then: The promise resolves with the rendered SVG, the generated width, height, and trimPadding values, after foreignObject changes are applied.
The promise rejects with an assertion error containing "Expected an SVG element", while cleanup is still scheduled.

units.name: applyChangesToForeignObjects

detail.name: applyChangesToForeignObjects
preconditions: svg is an SVGSVGElement with an ownerDocument supporting the required DOM and SVG APIs.
postconditions: If no export-owned foreignObject descendants exist, the function completes without processing or modifying the SVG.

Otherwise, media in each selected foreignObject descendant is embedded, computed styles and required CSS resources are embedded into the descendants, custom elements are unwrapped for serialization, and generated font or pseudo-element CSS is added to the SVG when present.
invariants: Only descendants of foreignObject elements matching the export embedding class are processed.
The function awaits asynchronous media embedding, CSS resource fetching, and font CSS generation before completing.
ForeignObject elements themselves are selected by the required class so unrelated shape-owned foreignObject elements are not processed.
edgeCases: When the selector returns no elements, the function returns a resolved Promise without constructing or invoking the style embedding workflow.
When selected descendants exist but no font CSS or pseudo-element CSS is produced, no additional SVG style element is added for those CSS results.
If media embedding, resource fetching, font CSS generation, or another processing step fails, the asynchronous operation does not produce a successful result.

raises: Errors from DOM operations, media embedding, stylesheet processing, resource fetching, font CSS generation, or style embedding propagate to the caller.
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit input validation or fallback behavior is defined; failures from using an invalid SVG-like value propagate.

stateMutations: Mutates selected foreignObject descendants by embedding media, replacing or unwrapping custom elements, and applying computed styles to style attributes.
May append a style element containing generated font-face and/or pseudo-element CSS to svg.
May mutate internal state of the StyleEmbedder while collecting styles and resources.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Mutates an SVG DOM tree in place. Any generated CSS is represented by an SVG <style> element created with the SVG namespace.
detail.summary: Asynchronously embeds media and computed styles for export-owned foreignObject descendants in an SVG, including required font and pseudo-element CSS resources. Existing foreignObject elements not marked for export embedding are left out of processing.

specLiterals.role: Selector restricting processing to descendants of export-owned foreignObject elements.
Namespace URI used when creating the generated SVG style element.
SVG element name used for generated CSS.

specTests.then: The Promise resolves without invoking media embedding or style embedding and without adding an SVG style element.

specTests.when: applyChangesToForeignObjects(svg) is awaited and all dependencies succeed.
specTests.then: Each selected descendant is processed for media and computed styles; custom elements are unwrapped; CSS resources and fonts are embedded; and an SVG style element is added if generated font or pseudo-element CSS is non-empty.
The returned Promise rejects rather than resolving successfully.
